headline: Gold Climbs Toward $3,900 on Dip Buying and Geopolitical Risks in Iran
summary: Gold rebounded toward $3,900 per ounce as dip buyers entered the market and geopolitical risks involving Iran continued to support safe-haven demand.
why: Gold is a traditional safe-haven asset that often sees increased demand during geopolitical tension and market uncertainty.

impacts.name: Gold
impacts.why: Gold prices climbed toward $3,900 as buyers stepped in on dips and geopolitical concerns persisted.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Gold prices moved higher as dip buyers returned to the market and lingering risks involving Iran sustained safe-haven demand.
